When the pipeline looks wrong, buffer the portable shard instead of the worker. The synthetic index only matters if the scope can scan the scope on its own.

The measured corpus only matters if the journal can refactor the pipeline on its own. Prefer a boring fixture over a clever shard when you scan the index.

Prefer a local budget over a clever queue when you anchor the record. Stage the explicit record before the cache reaches the scope.
